subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR expose provider-level retry config now, or limit the change to a proven `request.timeoutMs` field while configurable retry stays on the canonical retry issue?
rationale: The retry field creates a new public provider config contract that affects fallback timing and availability behavior, but the branch does not implement the runtime retry semantics.

options.title: Split Retry Out
options.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions here and review only a scoped, proven timeoutMs change while retry design continues on the canonical issue.

options.title: Implement Retry Fully
options.body: Keep the retry surface only if this PR also wires retryable error classification, backoff, fallback ordering, docs/baseline, and runtime tests.

options.title: Pause The PR
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers want one larger retry/fallback product decision before accepting nearby timeout config.

recommendation.title: Split Retry Out
recommendation.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions here and review only a scoped, proven timeoutMs change while retry design continues on the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest visible retry/failover routing signal through adjacent same-model retry and provider/config history.
